metadata.description: Cross-platform lineage map showing every object on every legacy platform mapped to its unified equivalent

BARCLAYS_RAW.CUSTOMER.notes: SET table dedup semantics preserved via ROW_NUMBER(). PRIMARY INDEX on customer_id removed (Snowflake micro-partitions). COMPRESS values removed. CHARACTER SET LATIN NOT CASESPECIFIC removed.

BARCLAYS_RAW.ACCOUNT.notes: PPI RANGE_N on open_date removed. COMPRESS values removed.

BARCLAYS_RAW.TRANSACTION.notes: PPI RANGE_N monthly partitioning removed. value_band and signed_amount derived in staging.

BARCLAYS_RAW.COUNTERPARTY.notes: Y/N flags converted to booleans. screening_category derived.

BARCLAYS_STG.V_CUSTOMER_LATEST.notes: QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() replaced with subquery. LOCK ROW FOR ACCESS removed.

BARCLAYS_STG.V_ACCOUNT_CURRENT.notes: ZEROIFNULL replaced with coalesce. derived_status logic preserved.

BARCLAYS_STG.V_TRANSACTION_ENRICHED.notes: value_band and signed_amount in staging; joins in intermediate.

BARCLAYS_STG.V_COUNTERPARTY_SCREENED.notes: screening_category derivation preserved in staging model.

BARCLAYS_DWH.DIM_CUSTOMER.notes: PERIOD data type replaced with dbt snapshot dbt_valid_from/dbt_valid_to. IDENTITY columns replaced with dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key.

BARCLAYS_DWH.FCT_TRANSACTION.notes: PPI RANGE_N replaced with Snowflake cluster_by.

BARCLAYS_DWH.FCT_DAILY_BALANCE.notes: MERGE INTO replaced with dbt incremental materialization.

BARCLAYS_MART.MART_REGULATORY_CAPITAL.notes: GROUP BY ROLLUP replaced with union all approach.

BARCLAYS_MART.MART_MONTHLY_PNL.notes: CSUM/MAVG OLAP functions replaced with standard window functions.

BARCLAYS_DWH.sp_daily_transaction_load.unified_equivalent: stg_teradata__* + int_unified_* + int_transaction_enriched + int_daily_account_balances + fct_daily_transactions + fct_daily_balances + snap_customer_risk_rating + snap_account_status
BARCLAYS_DWH.sp_daily_transaction_load.notes: 243-line procedure decomposed into multiple dbt models. SCD2 cursor loop replaced with dbt snapshot. MERGE INTO replaced with incremental materialization. COLLECT STATISTICS removed.

BARCLAYS_DWH.sp_customer_risk_scoring.notes: 208-line procedure decomposed into intermediate risk factors + mart scoring. VOLATILE TABLE replaced with CTE. HASHBUCKET/HASHROW replaced with hash().

BARCLAYS_DWH.sp_aml_screening.notes: 220-line procedure decomposed into intermediate flags + mart alerts. VOLATILE TABLEs replaced with CTEs. SOUNDEX preserved (native Snowflake). OREPLACE/OTRANSLATE replaced with replace/translate. LIKE ANY replaced with multiple LIKE OR.

BARCLAYS_DWH.sp_monthly_pnl_rollup.notes: 207-line procedure converted to single dbt model. GROUP BY ROLLUP logic preserved via union approach. CSUM -> sum() over(). MAVG -> avg() over().

BARCLAYS_DWH.sp_regulatory_capital_calc.notes: 144-line procedure converted to single dbt model. NORMALIZE ON removed. MDIFF replaced with lag().

daily_batch_load.bteq.notes: 88-line BTEQ script replaced with Snowflake Task DAG. .IF ERRORCODE/.GOTO replaced with Task error handling. .LOGON/.LOGOFF removed. Sequential CALL replaced with Task dependencies.

monthly_regulatory_report.bteq.notes: 75-line BTEQ script replaced with Snowflake Task DAG.

healthcare_raw.customer.notes: Delta Z-ORDER removed. address_line1 -> address_line_1 naming resolved.

healthcare_raw.account.notes: is_active boolean converted to status VARCHAR. currency_code -> currency. Delta partition by open_year removed.

healthcare_raw.transaction.notes: transaction_timestamp split to date+time. amount double -> numeric. Delta partition by transaction_month removed.

healthcare_raw.counterparty.notes: Boolean flags already in correct format.

PySpark transformation notebooks.notes: PySpark DataFrame operations extracted as SQL and rewritten as dbt models.

Auto Loader ingestion.notes: Databricks Auto Loader (cloudFiles) replaced with Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST.

HEALTHCARE_RAW.customer.notes: VARIANT address_json flattened to individual columns. customer_segment -> segment. email_address -> email. phone -> phone_number.

HEALTHCARE_RAW.account.notes: ccy -> currency. account_status -> status. opened_date -> open_date. closed_date -> close_date.

HEALTHCARE_RAW.transaction.notes: txn_id -> transaction_id. txn_date -> transaction_date. txn_type -> transaction_type. narrative -> description. running_balance -> balance_after. ref_number -> reference_number. ccy -> currency. txn_metadata VARIANT ignored (Snowflake-only extension).

HEALTHCARE_RAW.counterparty.notes: name -> counterparty_name. entity_type -> counterparty_type. VARIANT screening_flags JSON flattened to individual boolean columns.

Snowflake transformation procedures.notes: Transformation logic moved into dbt for version control, testing, and lineage.

Existing Snowflake Tasks.notes: Consolidated into unified Task DAG with proper dependencies.
